commands.command:
python3 -I -c '
import glob, re
src = "".join(open(f).read() for f in glob.glob("internal/mcpserver/tools/*.go") if not f.endswith("_test.go"))
known = set(re.findall(r"\"(workiva_[a-z_]+)\"", src))
for f in glob.glob("docs/demo/agent/*.md"):
    for n in set(re.findall(r"\bworkiva_[a-z_]+\b", open(f).read())):
        assert n in known, (f, n)
'

for n in workiva_prepare_section workiva_confirm_change_set workiva_stage_section_text workiva_confirm_section_text workiva_export_evidence; do grep -q $n docs/demo/agent/INSTRUCTIONS.md || exit 1; done
for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do grep -qE "^## Act $i" docs/demo/agent/DEMO_PROMPTS.md || exit 1; done && test $(grep -c 'Correct answer contains:' docs/demo/agent/DEMO_PROMPTS.md) -ge 8

for y in 2025 2024; do v=$(python3 -I -c "import csv; print([r['value'] for r in csv.DictReader(open('configs/demo/data/esg-$y.csv')) if r['key']=='energy_total'][0])") && grep -qF "$v" docs/demo/agent/DEMO_PROMPTS.md || exit 1; done
